description: Ranks features, initiatives or customer problems with RICE, ICE, weighted scoring or Opportunity Score tied to strategic pillars, giving a ranked list, sequence and cut line; also explains which framework to use. Use when the user says prioritize my backlog, RICE score, rank these initiatives, what should we build next, or which prioritization framework. Not for sequencing a multi-team quarterly roadmap (use roadmap-planning).
